title: Deep learning-based high-resolution time inference for deciphering dynamic gene regulation from fixed embryos.
authors: Bao, Huihan; Zhang, Shihe; Yu, Zhiyang; Xu, Heng
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习从固定胚胎图像推断发育时间，结合理论模型解析TF调控下的基因动态表达，虽涉及TF-DNA调控但非直接互作建模，方法可迁移至时间分辨的TF-DNA动态研究。
abstract: Embryo development is driven by the spatiotemporal dynamics of complex gene regulatory networks. Uncovering these dynamics requires simultaneous tracking of multiple fluctuating molecular species over time, which exceeds the capabilities of traditional live-imaging approaches. Fixed-embryo imaging offers the necessary sensitivity and capacity but lacks temporal resolution. Here, we present a multi-scale ensemble deep learning approach to precisely infer absolute developmental time with 1-minute resolution from nuclear morphology in fixed Drosophila embryo images. Applying this approach to quantitative imaging of fixed wild-type embryos, we resolve the spatiotemporal regulation of the endogenous segmentation gene Kruppel (Kr) by multiple transcription factors (TFs) during early development without genetic modification. Integrating a time-resolved theoretical model of single-molecule mRNA statistics, we further uncover the unsteady-state bursty kinetics of the endogenous segmentation gene, hunchback (hb), driven by dynamic TF binding. Our method provides a versatile framework for deciphering complex gene network dynamics in genetically unmodified organisms.
abstract_zh: 胚胎发育由复杂基因调控网络的时空动态所驱动。揭示这些动态过程需要同时追踪多种随时间波动的分子种类，这超出了传统活体成像方法的能力范围。固定胚胎成像提供了必要的灵敏度和容量，但缺乏时间分辨率。在此，我们提出一种多尺度集成深度学习方法，能够从固定果蝇胚胎图像的核形态中精确推断出具有1分钟分辨率的绝对发育时间。将该方法应用于固定野生型胚胎的定量成像，我们无需遗传修饰即可解析早期发育过程中内源性分割基因Kruppel（Kr）受多种转录因子（TFs）的时空调控。结合单分子mRNA统计的时间分辨理论模型，我们进一步揭示了由动态TF结合驱动的内源性分割基因hunchback（hb）的非稳态爆发式动力学。我们的方法为解析未遗传修饰生物体中复杂基因网络动态提供了一个通用框架。
